title: A chocolate egg sold for seven thousand pounds

sources.title: Guinness World Records report, 21 March 2012
claims: A 50 kilogram chocolate egg sold for £7,000 at a London charity auction in March 2012.
It was designed by William Curley.
Seven chocolatiers worked for three days.
Fillings included muscovado caramel, Japanese black vinegar, rosemary and olive oil.
The report described a non-jewelled chocolate egg record in 2012, not a current record.

scenes.text: Seven thousand pounds for chocolate. This happened at a London charity auction in twenty twelve.
The egg weighed fifty kilos and was designed by chocolatier William Curley.
Seven chocolatiers spent three days making it.
Inside were fillings including caramel, Japanese black vinegar, rosemary and olive oil.
Guinness reported the non-jewelled chocolate egg record then. This is a historical auction story.
Would you break it open, or keep it untouched? Pick your side.
